title: As-Built Surveys & Construction Documentation Las Vegas | VTLV
description: Las Vegas as-built surveys, 3D reality capture, construction progress documentation and insurance-ready digital twins by Mike Madsen. Matterport-based measurement, Matterpak BIM exports, and aerial progress imagery for builders, contractors, architects and adjusters.
headline: 3D reality capture, without the return site visit.
lead: As-built surveys, construction progress documentation, and insurance-ready digital twins. Matterport-based 3D scanning captures precise measurements in a single visit, eliminating the manual measurements and return trips that drag traditional surveys out for weeks.
